title: This is not a Getting Things Done app
body:
You might have seen this app on a list of Getting Things Done apps, but beware that it can’t be used to implement the GTD methodology. In particular, if a task is not yet relevant, GTD recomends that you create a reminder for the task in the future, so you can forget about it until then. Todoist allows you to make reminders on tasks, but the task will still be lying around in whatever contexts it is in: the task does not get snoozed, and will instead take up mental energy every time you look at your next actions lists. 

Otherwise seems like a decent app

title: Great potential, but....
body:
I have tried many different to-do apps, and todoist is amongst the better. But: 
1) You need Premium to get a decent synchronisation result between different devices. 
2) The IOS widget is, at its best, very unreliable. Maybe you see your tasks - maybe not. If you complete them in the widget, that info is not shared anywhere. The task remains open, until you open the app, which removes the idea of having an interactive widget.
3) Notifications... does not work well. Support tells me it is an Apple problem on IOS10, but it works for other apps.
I ended up replacing todoist with TickTick.

title: Okay, but has sync issues
body: "Todoist" is a great service that works cross platform. I'm a huge fan. It works nicely, and it has a simple and elegant design. However, the iPhone app has issues with synchronizing, so sometimes you have duplicate tasks, and other times tasks you've marked as complete on the website, keeps showing up on your due list. This is so annoying, and it's been like this for at least 6 months. I've reported it to them, but they say they've never experienced any sync issues, and can't reproduce any, and so they don't seem to be doing anything about it. New versions of the app keep coming, but the sync issues persist. I really wish they would fix this, but when I've reported it to them, they talk about it like I'm the only one experiencing this, while their support forum has several threads about sync issues with the iPhone app. If there were any better alternative, I would jump ship immediately. So if you plan to use this app while using the website, be prepared for sync issues. When this is fixed, which I hope eventually it will be, I would have no problems rating this 5 stars. But until then, I'm only rating it 2, because task synchronization is the primary use for this. So when that doesn't work consistently, that has to impact the rating severely.
